branding.hero_subheadline: A calm, welcoming hair studio in Koregaon Park, Pune. Specialized in custom haircuts, gentle ammonia-free hair colors, scalp spa, and bridal styling.

manifesto.section_title: Relaxed, Honest Hair Care in Pune
manifesto.lead_quote: We believe a salon visit should feel relaxing, friendly, and unhurried. We listen to what you want, explain each step, and give you hair that looks great every day.

pillars.title: Peaceful Environment
pillars.subtitle: No noisy chaos or pressure sales
pillars.description: Clean, spacious styling stations with comfortable seating and soothing background music. You can unwind, read, or have a quiet conversation.

pillars.title: Natural Daylight Styling
pillars.subtitle: Accurate color preview before you leave
pillars.description: Our mirrors and color wash area are lit with daylight-balanced lighting so your hair color looks exactly the same outdoors on Pune roads as it does in our chair.

pillars.title: Gentle & Safe Products
pillars.subtitle: Ammonia-free colors & nourishing hair spa
pillars.description: We only use certified gentle hair colors and deep conditioning plant masks from Olaplex and L'Oreal Professionnel that keep your scalp healthy.

press_quotes.quote: An oasis of calm in busy Koregaon Park. Pooja Sharma's haircuts are thoughtful, unhurried, and perfectly suited to daily wear.
press_quotes.author: Anjali Chitnis

press_quotes.quote: One of the best salons in Pune for ammonia-free balayage and relaxing hair spas. Clean, elegant, and completely pressure-free.
press_quotes.author: Tanvi Rao

client_reviews.review: Got my caramel balayage done with Rohit in Koregaon Park. He understood my hair texture and gave me a shade that looks so natural under daylight. Truly relaxing experience.
Finally a salon in Pune where they don't force you to buy expensive packages! Clean chairs, polite staff, and Pooja's haircut was exactly what I showed her on my phone.
Booked their bridal hair package for my reception. Pooja and Meera did an amazing job with soft curls that stayed intact through 6 hours of dancing.
